model_output:
```sql
WITH viewpoint_geom AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-73.979395, 40.759034), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
dem_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(rast, ST_Transform(geom, 4326)::geometry, TRUE) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us, viewpoint_geom
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(geom, 4326)::geometry)
),
avg_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(ST_Value(clipped_rast, 1)) AS avg_elev
  FROM 
    dem_clip
),
viewpoint_elevation AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Value(rast, 1) AS elev
  FROM 
    public.dem_us, viewpoint_geom
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(geom, 4326)::geometry)
)
SELECT 
  'Top of the Rock' AS poi_name,
  (SELECT avg_elev FROM avg_elevation) AS avg_elevation,
  (SELECT elev FROM viewpoint_elevation) AS viewpoint_elevation,
  CASE 
    WHEN (SELECT elev FROM viewpoint_elevation) > (SELECT avg_elev FROM avg_elevation) THEN 'Above average elevation'
    ELSE 'Not above average elevation'
  END AS elevation_status;
```
